Field aid — not a contract document. Pile geometry from the RW732 / RW760 pile schedules and the plans as entered in the Zone A viewer (August 2026). Offsets to the track are an assumed 31 ft (the contractor's figure; the plans read 26 ft "and varies") until surveyed — a measured value entered on a pile card replaces it for that pile. Zone A (UPRR & BNSF Guidelines for Temporary Shoring, 12/7/2021, Figure 1) is shown for information; after the railroad agreement it is not a construction control. The railroad agreement in the Information Handout binds the contractor to the UPRR manual (SS 5-1.20C). Sequence, checks and troubleshooting compiled from the 2024 Standard Specifications and the BCR&P Manual (Bridge Construction Memos); the contract, the special provisions and the current published memos govern; where documents disagree this book uses the latest edition and, between current documents, the more conservative value (Reference → Manuals → governing values). Records you enter here are yours and replace no form: the SC-3803 / 3805 / 3806 and the signed daily report (CEM-4601 for the ASR, CEM-4501 for the SR) are still the record.
